title: Code reviews per week
description: Code reviews per week since February 2024, the review bot and humans stacked: humans peaked at 56 a week, the bot at 161. Drawn from the weekly data in _code-reviews/data.js.
series: Code reviews: humans and the bot
source: code_reviews_weekly.csv (weekly reviews, Feb 5, 2024 to Nov 8, 2026), and the brief's per-pull-request figures (371 pull requests, 374k lines, about 300 hours saved: 5 min per pull request plus 1 h per 500 lines changed, at most 2 h, repeat reviews not counted), all as of Nov 8, 2026.
